office_does: The District Court judge hears misdemeanors, traffic infractions, small claims and civil cases up to the statutory limit for all of Skamania County; nonpartisan, four-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Christopher Robert Lanz, a Klickitat County Superior Court commissioner, is the only candidate; Judge Ron Reynier, elected in 2022, is not on the ballot.

candidates.summary: Klickitat County Superior Court Commissioner who has sat as a judge pro tem in Skamania District and Superior Courts and both Klickitat District Courts.
highlights: Klickitat County Superior Court Commissioner, appointed by Judge Randy Krog [S1]
Judge pro tem in Skamania District Court, Skamania Superior Court and Klickitat District Courts [S1]
